purpose: one-epoch compute-only calibration of an equivalent diagonal-Jacobian implementation at 4 Torch threads
deviations: CPU execution instead of the paper's A100 GPU
one epoch instead of 100; this node is resource calibration and cannot verify a scientific claim
the official Dataset casts each item to float32 on every access; this calibration materializes exactly the same float32 tensors once and machine-checks bitwise equality at fixed indices

the released transition prior materializes a full batch-by-batch Jacobian and extracts its diagonal; this calibration computes the identical diagonal as grad(output.sum(), input) and checks forward values, parameter gradients, and one Adam update against the released path
num_workers is zero to avoid interprocess copies of an already memory-resident dataset
